answer: Locks are entered in wharf, expire in quill, and mesa lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 178 aliases therefore needs 136 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4518 identities would post 626 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
